topic: Mastering the Cross Product: From 2D intuition to 3D mechanics

sections.title: Conceptual Foundations (Prerequisites)
lecture_lines: Vectors are directed segments in space.
The cross product creates a perpendicular vector.
animations: Fade in two vectors in #FFFFFF. Label them #FF0000.
Show dot product result as a scalar value. Label #00FF00.
Illustrate vector projection visually with a dotted line #FFFF00.

sections.title: 2D 'Cross Product' as Oriented Area
lecture_lines: The 2D cross product measures oriented area.
A parallelogram forms between two vectors.
animations: Show parallelogram spanning vectors with area fill #FF00FF.
Animate area change as one vector moves. Color #FF00FF.
Show orientation change as vectors flip. Color #FFFF00.

sections.title: The 3D Cross Product Mechanics
lecture_lines: Magnitude relates to sin of the angle.
The result is a vector in 3D.
Magnitude grows as base vectors separate.
Propellers illustrate the resulting thrust vector.
animations: Render 3D coordinate system in #FFFFFF. Label axes #FF0000.
Animate the cross product vector perpendicular to both #FFFF00.
Show Right-Hand Rule thumb orientation in #00FF00.
Highlight the resulting vector's magnitude label #00FFFF.

sections.title: Geometric Interpretations & Applications
lecture_lines: Cross products find surface normal vectors.
Torque calculation is a primary application.
Zero cross product means vectors are collinear.
animations: Show parallelogram area as magnitude of cross product #FF00FF.
Animate normal vector direction for surface orientation #00FF00.
Visualize torque as cross product of force and radius #FFFF00.
